ja: 私たちは今、銀行の窓口で順番を待っているところです。
en: We're waiting for our turn at the bank.
alternatives: We're waiting in line at the bank now.
We're standing in line at the bank right now.

ja: 兄は今日の午後、修理に出したノートパソコンを受け取りにお店へ行く予定です。
en: My brother is going to the repair shop this afternoon to pick up his laptop.
alternatives: My brother plans to go to the repair shop this afternoon to pick up his laptop.
This afternoon my brother is going to the repair shop to get his laptop back.
point: 「〜しに行く」の目的は to 不定詞で後ろに置く

ja: 郵便局の人が、この小包は明日届くって言ってたよ。
en: The person at the post office said this package would arrive tomorrow.
alternatives: The post office clerk said this package will arrive tomorrow.
The guy at the post office told me this package would arrive tomorrow.
point: said の後の that 節は will を would に揃えることが多い

ja: 先週キャッシュカードをなくしたんですが、もう銀行で再発行してもらいました。
en: I lost my bank card last week, but I've already had it reissued.
alternatives: I lost my bank card last week, but the bank has already reissued it.
I lost my ATM card last week, but I've already gotten a new one from the bank.
point: 先週は過去形、「もう〜した」は現在完了で分ける
